adverse_variants_to_freeze_before_scorin: nearby latent distractors without oracle-based filtering of methods
higher noise and independent update churn
fresh coordinates/identity draws and label reassignment
no values that expose query views or correspondences at inference
broad_claim_limit: Code-visible synthetic evaluator and runner-private fresh final are local evidence; general capability, LLM replacement or real-world economics require independent tasks and independently blinded evaluation.
decision_rule: Retain as the new screening cohort only when input-boundary tests and learning requirement/competence controls pass. If not, diagnose the failed map/loss/data factor and assess another preregistered alternative; do not close the whole program for one recipe. A memory advantage needs the unchanged economic gates, strong classical non-domination, source-identical ablations, adverse variants and five fresh final units after source/recipe freeze.
full_cost_boundary: data acquisition/generation and training separately reported and included in deployment amortization assumptions
fit including failures and all validation/hyperparameter search
raw input parsing and dtype/device copies
session/model allocation, ingest and initial embedding/index construction
every replacement including index removal/rebuild or state correction
every warmup and cache fill, with cold and warm workloads explicit
query representation, retrieval/attention/state read, UNKNOWN decision and output decoding
CPU/GPU synchronized total workload; peak RSS/CUDA plus logical state and bytes; operation estimates labeled; no wall-time complexity claim
implementation_entry: A separate frozen reference-study plan, cloned validation, current integrity/preflight and readiness are required before scoring; this preparation study performs no generator/model implementation or training.
learning_controls: same source with shuffled positive train correspondences, preregistered once
raw-space cosine or nearest-neighbor retrieval without fit
linear ridge/CCA view transport fit only from the same legal positive pairs; training-only hyperparameter selection
nonlinear kernel-ridge view transport from the same legal pairs, with preregistered bounded grid
exact nearest-neighbor retrieval using the identical trained encoder, charging the full encoder fit and index
strong classical indexed retrieval added before mechanism scoring when applicable; never silently omitted

learning_requirement_gate.interpretation: learning of an observation map must matter on fresh identities; this gate cannot prove neural learning is intrinsically required or transfer beyond this task

matrix.axes_limit: update history depth is independent of K; it is not recursive reasoning depth or compositional transfer
matrix.known_strata: where updates exist, half known queries target updated records and half retained records; with0 updates all are retention

private_generator.A_B: independent orthonormal-column64x16 matrices per independent seed/data unit, realized from separate runner-private entropy after preregistration; not derived from the candidate seed or passed protocol
private_generator.freshness: distinct namespace/nonces for train/dev and later final; a unit shares its observation map across those splits but never identities or noise realizations; candidate roles share exact raw arrays and training correspondences
private_generator.identities: independent normalized Gaussian16-vectors newly drawn per episode; no finite train/test identity vocabulary
private_generator.structural_resampling: none: preserve confusable random cases, do not filter by model outcome
private_generator.values: uniform0..15, independent of latent identity; replacements change the previous value
private_generator.visibility: candidate sees only legal public arrays and supervised train correspondences; evaluator alone knows latent identities, absence and view parameters

public_input.query: 64 float32 coordinates; no handle, latent key, teacher coefficients or answer flags
public_input.write: timestamp:int, opaque stable write handle:int, observation:64 float32 coordinates, value:int in0..15
public_input.write_handle_rule: all methods may use the stable handle only to replace an earlier version of that record; queries never expose it; charge parsing, map maintenance and compaction

purpose: Measure learned query-to-record alignment, absence and mutable-memory inference cost on new unseen continuous identities; this is a scoped synthetic memory test, not a language-model or intelligence claim.
reason_for_new_cohort: MUC exposes exact string keys and timestamp semantics; a legal last-write map solves all valid worlds without learning. Changing MUC after its results would not preserve a coherent comparison cohort.
reference_controls: First reference study must freeze a conventional dense softmax Transformer with legal caching/compaction, plus a dense attention pointer control. Exact architecture, fit recipe, loss, fixed finite classical grids and worker caps are separately preregistered before any implementation. A name alone does not establish competence.
